results.text: The document investigates graph indexing with a dual‑level retrieval system, evaluating it on four corpora—Agriculture, Computer Science, Legal, and a mixed set. Reported results show the proposed method outperforms the baseline on the Agriculture, CS, and Legal datasets, while the mixed dataset yields a slight advantage for the baseline, so universal superiority is not claimed. The authors also describe an incremental‑update mechanism that incorporates new data without requiring a full graph rebuild.
